Content: A block on a level horizontal surface of negligible friction is initially traveling at `20` `text(m)//text(s)` to the left. A horizontal force `vecF` is exerted to the right on the block for the time interval `0<t<0.10` `text(s)`. The magnitude of the force is given as a function of time `t` by the equation `F=alphat`, where `alpha=240` `text(N)//text(s)` and `t` is in `text(seconds)`.
